scope: All authored Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, CSS and JSON in games/hotlinemiami and scripts/hotlinemiami; this is not a whole-repository check
rules: All code comments and Python docstrings are prohibited
TypeScript/JavaScript and Go bindings use camelCase/PascalCase; uppercase snake constants are permitted in TypeScript/JavaScript
Python bindings use snake_case, uppercase snake constants, and PascalCase classes
Go package names match engine, server, data, command and test directory roles
Business Go uses integer types and integer numeric literals; input and prediction TypeScript reject fractional numeric constants, Number.EPSILON and Math.random
Dynamic evaluation, TypeScript any, cross-game implementation imports, direct audio players and embedded media payloads are prohibited
Temporary output paths are restricted to .local/hotlinemiami and system-default temporary directories are prohibited
CSS classes and custom properties use kebab-case; JSON must parse and cannot contain prototype keys
Symlink traversal and unsupported source locations are rejected

assets/public is externally restored payload: exclude it from authored source parsing only while every file is registered and verified against assets/resources.json bytes and SHA-256; authored assets metadata outside public remains checked
